author: Second Wind
description:
This video is brought to you by PlayTracker, the app that tracks your cross-platform game library, achievements, stats, and more! Join the Second Wind guild today! – https://playtracker.net/secondwind/

On this week’s Semi-Ramblomatic, Yahtzee takes aim at the consistently terrible storytelling of the Resident Evil series, with a focus on the latest game, Resident Evil Requiem. While the franchise's dumb charm is usually forgivable, some bad writing is harder to swallow than a Jill sandwich.
